你家有几口人？ (Nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ kǒu rén?) - How many people are there in your family?
我家有…… (Wǒ jiā yǒu……) - There are … people in my family.
你/你爸爸/你妈妈……今年多大了？ (Nǐ/Nǐ bàba/Nǐ māma……jīnnián duō dà le?) - How old are you / is your father / is your mother this year?
我/我爸爸/我妈妈……今年…… (Wǒ/Wǒ bàba/Wǒ māma……jīnnián……) - I am / my father is / my mother is … this year.
我家有……人。 (Wǒ jiā yǒu……rén.) - There are … people in my family.
这是我……，这是我……，这是我…… (Zhè shì wǒ……，zhè shì wǒ……，zhè shì wǒ……) - This is my …, this is my …, this is my …
……叫……，他/她是……，他/她今年……了。 (……jiào……，tā/tā shì……，tā/tā jīnnián……le.) - … is called …, he/she is …, he/she is … years old this year.
你今年几岁了？ (Nǐ jīnnián jǐ suì le?) - How old are you? (asked of children younger than 10)
你今年多大了？ (Nǐ jīnnián duō dà le?) - How old are you? (asked of a young person or someone of one's own age)
您今年多大年纪了？ (Nín jīnnián duō dà niánjì le?) - What is your age? (asked of an elder person, to show respect)
你会说汉语吗？ (Nǐ huì shuō Hànyǔ ma?) - Can you speak Chinese?
我会说汉语。 (Wǒ huì shuō Hànyǔ.) - Yes, I can speak Chinese.
你妈妈会说汉语吗？ (Nǐ māma huì shuō Hànyǔ ma?) - Can your mother speak Chinese?
她不会说。 (Tā bú huì shuō.) - No, she can't speak it.
对不起 (duìbuqǐ) - sorry
这个 (zhège) - this (as in 这个字, this character)
中国菜好吃吗？ (Zhōngguó cài hǎochī ma?) - Is Chinese food delicious?
中国菜很好吃。 (Zhōngguó cài hěn hǎochī.) - Chinese food is quite delicious.
你会做中国菜吗？ (Nǐ huì zuò Zhōngguó cài ma?) - Can you cook Chinese food?
我不会做。 (Wǒ bú huì zuò.) - No, I can't (cook it).
你会写汉字吗？ (Nǐ huì xiě Hànzì ma?) - Can you write Chinese characters?
我会写。 (Wǒ huì xiě.) - Yes, I can write them.
这个字怎么写？ (Zhège zì zěnme xiě?) - How do you write this character?
对不起，这个字我会读，不会写。 (Duìbuqǐ, zhège zì wǒ huì dú, bú huì xiě.) - Sorry. I can read this character, but I don't know how to write it.
我会写汉字。 (Wǒ huì xiě Hànzì.) - I can write Chinese characters.
我不会做中国菜。 (Wǒ bú huì zuò Zhōngguó cài.) - I can't cook Chinese food.
